CustomField.description: Age in full years, calculated from Date of Birth. This is a read-only formula field.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(DOB__c), 0, YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(DOB__c) - IF( OR( MONTH(TODAY()) < MONTH(DOB__c), AND(MONTH(TODAY()) = MONTH(DOB__c), DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(DOB__c)) ), 1, 0 ) )
CustomField.label: Age
